Highlights:
## Crucial® T500 Gen4 SSD with heatsink

Battle better.

## Elevate your PS5 play with the Crucial T500 Gen4 SSD — your perfect in-game ally

## Crucial T500 PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD with heatsink

Fuel your system performance with the Crucial® T500 Gen4 NVMe® SSD. Experience faster gaming – perfect for PS5™ upgrades. Amp up your creative potential with solid state storage that moves as fast as you need it to. Heavy tasks are no problem with better performance to power efficiency, and our heatsink gives you quiet heat dissipation in a sleek design.

### Fast: Up to 7,400/7,000MB/s sequential reads/writes2

### Spacious: 1TB and 2TB3

### Generation: PCIe® 4.0 NVMe M.2 2280 SSD

### Innovation: The world’s first 232-layer TLC NAND engineered by Micron

### Warranty: 5-year limited8

### Heatsink: Heatsink version is easy to install in your PlayStation® 5 (non-heatsink option also available)

Speed up boots, loads, and saves with 7,400/7,000MB/s sequential reads/writes2 — the Crucial T500 PCle® 4.0 NVMe SSD is more than 2x faster5 than Gen3 SSDs and 12x faster5 than SATA.

As a PS5™ diehard, you get faster load times and powerful storage for all your favorite games. With our integrated heatsink and powerful Gen4 engineering, the T500 exceeds PS5 requirements9 for the ultimate gaming experience.

Real tests don’t lie — load games 16% faster1 with the Crucial T500 PCle 4.0 NVMe SSD. Store more games with up to 2TB3 of storage. With Microsoft® DirectStorage, render faster6 and enjoy more detailed game textures.

Get more done in less time with the T500’s power efficiency. With up to a 40% higher performance to power ratio4, the Crucial T500 PCle 4.0 NVMe SSD helps keep your computer working faster with less power.

...

Highlights:
The Crucial T500 PCIe Gen4 SSD offers top-tier Gen4 sequential read and write speeds7 up to 7,400/7,000MB/s and optimal power to performance efficiency. With its integrated, premium heatsink, the Crucial T500 is perfect for adding storage to PlayStation 5 console gaming systems, for PC gaming and creative professionals who need powerful Gen4 performance. A non-heatsink option is also available.

...

Fuel your system performance with the Crucial T500 Gen4 NVMe SSD. Load games up to 16% faster6 with sequential read and write speeds7 up to 7,400MB/s and 7,000MB/s (up to 1.18M/1.44M IOPs random reads/writes7). Perfect for PS5™, the T500 serves up faster gaming, video editing, and 3D rendering. Easy to install and with up to 2TB of storage8, the T500 gives you plenty of space for all your games or projects. Built with cutting-edge TLC NAND, up to a 40% performance-to-power ratio9, and speeds that are 2x faster10 than Gen3, the T500 optimizes your system performance so it can work faster with less power. Enabled for Microsoft DirectStorage, the T500 also supports faster11 renders and reduced CPU utilization for a richer gaming experience.

...

The Crucial T700 SSD is available in 1TB, 2TB and 4TB capacities8 in both heatsink and non-heatsink M.2 2280 form factor options. The Crucial T500 SSD is available in 1TB and 2TB capacities in both heatsink and non-heatsink M.2 2280 form factor options. Crucial DDR5 Pro memory is available in 16GB, 24GB, 32GB and 48GB UDIMM modules with speeds up to 6,000MT/s, while the DDR4 Pro memory is offered in 16GB and 32GB 3,200MT/s UDIMM modules. Crucial DDR5 Pro Overclocking Memory is available in 16GB 6,000MT/s UDIMM modules. All Crucial Pro Series products are available worldwide from leading retail and e-tail stores, commercial resellers and system integrators.
